title: European NUTS2 employment across all published age groups
source: Eurostat lfst_r_lfe2emp and prior fixed regional THAIE linkage
note: The European overview uses the same 208 NUTS-2 regions across all 12 age groups, 2020–2025. Country and individual-region views are subsets of this fixed cohort. All occupations and both sexes combined. Regional exposure is not individual occupational exposure. Boundary and public-cell scope uncertainty remain.
